name: Cloudflare
why: Cheapest domain prices and cloudflare works great for everything for me.

quotes.quote: Cheapest domain prices and cloudflare works great for everything for me.
quotes.excerpt: Minecraft $26.95. Thousands of hours of gameplay. Ear Fun Free Pro 3 $50 wireless earbuds. Great sound, quick pairing, good noise cancelling, in-app equalizer, great price. Probably buy direct from them, bought from Woot! Amazon once and didn't get a very good model. Web Video Caster $5. I stream tons of content and this lets me connect to just about anything. You can use it for free with ads. Cloudflare domain ~$10/
quotes.story: Ask HN: What are your best purchases under $100?

quotes.quote: I use cloudflare and it's great.
quotes.excerpt: I use cloudflare and it's great. It feels like the only registrar that has a business case for at cost domains. Also if you're worried about cloudflare downtime, you can only use them for dns resolution (which hasn't been impacted) and not for proxying.
quotes.story: Ask HN: Which domain name registrar do you use?

quotes.quote: If there were an alternative to Cloudflare, I'd leave your service and move my systems elsewhere.
quotes.excerpt: I think you should give me a credit for all the income I lost due to this outage. Who authorized a change to the core infrastructure during the period of the year when your customers make the most income? Seriously, this is a management failure at the highest levels of decision-making.
